newsitem.title: USA: American Medical says plans name change.
newsitem.headline: American Medical says plans name change.

text.p: American Medical Technologies Inc said it will seek shareholder approval to change its name to Tidel Technologies Inc.
As part of the name change, the company plans to change its Nasdaq trading symbol to "ATMS."
The company is asking its shareholders to approve the name change at the company's annual meeting in June 1997, while the symbol change will take effect on or about May 1, 1997.

The company, which has been doing business as AMT Industries Inc since March 1995, said the name is a blend of American Medical Technologies and Tidel Engineering, its wholly owned subsidiary and sole operation.

James Rash, Chairman and CEO, said "the name change represents the final step of the company's transition from a medical services company into a developer and manufacturer of automated teller machines and cash security systems."
AMT Industries is a manufacturer of automated teller machines and cash security systems.
